verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yopisio juntzanhxo heb' sk'ayb'um Jesús, 72 sb'isul heb'. Ix sb'ab'laj chekanb'at heb'. Chatakwanhil ix aj sb'at heb' t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun lugar b'aj ol ek' pax Jesús chi'.

Ayik manto b'at heb', ix yalan t'a heb': --Ha heb' anima tik, lajanxo heb' icha ixim trigo stiempo'alxo sjochchaji. Wal yel niwanto heb', palta jaywannhej mach smunlaj t'a skal heb'. Yuj chi', lesalwanhek t'a jun aj munlajel chi', yik ol schekb'at heb' smunlajwum b'at yik'cha'anh heb'.
Ixikek a ex tik. Icha tz'aj sb'at nok' kalnel t'a skal nok' okes, icha chi' tz'aj ex in chekanb'ati.
Manh eyik'b'at he pa, yet'tal he tumin yet' pax he xanhab'. Manh ex och linhan lolonel yet' heb' anima tze cha t'a yoltak b'e.
Ayik tzex k'och t'a junok pat, tzeyak'an stzatzil sk'ol heb' icha tik: Ayokab' junk'olal t'a yol he pat tik, xe chi t'a heb'.
Tato ay heb' snib'an junk'olal chi', ol ak'jok t'a heb' icha tz'aj eyalan chi'. Tato max snib'ej heb' jun, manh ol elk'ochlaj icha tzeyal chi' t'a heb'.
Anhej t'a jun pat chi' tzeyak' he posado. Ha tas swa heb' tze wa yet' heb', yujto a mach smunlaji, smoj scha'an stojol. Max yal tonhej tzex b'eyek' t'a kaltak pat.
Ayik tzex k'och t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj tzex chaji, tze wanhej tas syak' heb' t'ayex.
Tzeyak' b'oxok sk'ol heb' pena'ay b'aj tzex k'och chi', tzeyalan t'a heb': Stiempo'alxo eyoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xe chi t'a heb'.
Tato max ex chaji t'a junok chonhab' b'aj tzex k'ochi, tzex ek' t'a yoltak calle, tzeyalan icha tik:
Ha spokokal jun he chonhab' tik ix kan t'a kok, sko tzikkaneli, sko ch'oxankaneli to manhxa kalan kik t'ayex. Palta nachajokab'el eyu'uj to stiempo'alxo eyoch t'a yol sk'ab' Dios, xe chi t'a heb'.
Ha in tik swal t'ayex to ayik ol ja sk'uhal yik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima, más niwan syahelal jun chonhab' chi' ol ak'jok t'a yichanh heb' aj Sodoma.

Ha ex wal tik ex aj Corazín yet' ex ex aj Betsaida, te chuk eyiko'. Oktom t'a chonhab' Tiro yet' t'a chonhab' Sidón b'ob'il juntzanh milagro icha ix in b'o t'a he kal tik. Tato icha chi', pekataxom snanak sb'a heb' ay t'a chonhab' chi'. Yak'nak am och juntzanh spichul heb' ya swa'i, yak'nak am k'e k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh heb' t'a sjolom, yik scheklaji to skus heb' yuj smul.
Palta ha t'a sk'uhal yik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' anima, ek'al yahelal ol ak'jokoch t'a eyib'anh t'a yichanh heb' aj Tiro yet' heb' aj Sidón chi'.
Hanhejtona' ex pax tik ex aj Capernaum, ¿tom tze na to ol eyik'cha'anh he b'a? Swal t'ayex to ol ex lajwokelok.

Xal ex in k'ayb'um ex, a heb' ol cha'an yab' t'ayex, syalelk'ochi, a t'ayin ol scha yab' heb'. Ha heb' tzex patikaneli, syalelk'ochi, a in tzin spatikejel heb'. Ha heb' tzin patikanel chi', a jun chekjinak in koti, a spatikejel heb', xchi Jesús t'a heb' sk'ayb'um chi'.
Ix jax heb' 72 t'a tzalajk'olal, ix yalan heb': --Mamin, a heb' enemigo ix sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ix kala' ayik ix kak'lab'an a b'i, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a heb': --Ha in tik wilnak tas ajnak skot winh Satanás t'a satcha'anh yemnak ul winh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, icha yek' kopnaj lheb'lon ayik sk'anh k'u.
Ha in tik swak' eyopisio yik syal eyem tek'tek' t'a yib'anh nok' chan yet' nok' sina'an, yik tzeyak'an ganar t'a yib'anh jantaknhej yipalil winh eyajk'o'ol. Malaj junok tas syal ex yixtani.
Manh yujok to tzex sk'anab'ajej heb' enemigo tzex tzalaji, palta tzalajanhek yujto tz'ib'ab'ilxo he b'i t'a satcha'anh, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.

Ha t'a jun rato chi', a Jesús ix te tzalaj yuj Yespíritu Dios, ix yalani: --Mamin, a ach Yajal ach t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto ix a k'ub'ejel juntzanh tik t'a heb' jelan yet' t'a heb' ek'al spensar t'a yichanh heb' yetanima'il. Haxo t'a heb' emnakil syutej sb'a icha unin ix ak' ojtakajelok. Icha chi' ix utej Mamin, yujto icha chi' ix el t'a a k'o'ol, xchi Jesús t'a slesal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a heb' anima ayek' ta': --Ha in Mam ak'jinak masanil tastak t'a yol in k'ab'. Malaj mach ojtannak in a in Yuninal in tik. Anhej in Mam chi' ojtannak in. Hanheja', malaj mach ojtannak in Mam chi', a innhej Yuninal in wojtak yet' heb' in gana swak' yojtakejeli, xchi Jesús t'a heb'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix ek' k'elelok t'a heb' sk'ayb'um, ix yalan t'a heb' icha tik: --Wach' yik heb' tz'ilan juntzanh tzeyil tik.

Wal yel swal t'ayex to tzijtum heb' schekab' Dios t'a peka' yet' heb' rey snib'ejnak yil jun wan eyilan tik, palta manh yilnakoklaj heb'. Hanhejtona' jun wan eyab'an tik, snib'ej heb' yab'nak, palta manh yab'nakoklaj heb', xchi t'a heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ay jun winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés ix k'e linhan. Ix snib'ej winh ix yak' prowal Jesús, yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winh t'ay: --Ach ko k'ayb'umal, ¿tas ol aj in cha'an in k 'inal t'a junelnhej? xchi winh.
--¿Tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés? ¿Tas xchi ayik tzawtan yab' heb' anima? xchi Jesús chi' t'a winh.

--Syal icha tik: Tze xajanej Kajal ko Diosal t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, t'a smasanil he pixan, t'a smasanil eyip, t'a smasanil he pensar. Icha eya'ilan he b'a, icha'okab' chi' he xajanan heb' ay t'a spatik schikin he pat, xchi winh t'a Jesús.
--Wach' ix utej halani, tato icha chi' tzutej a b'a, ol a cha a k 'inal t'a junelnhej, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Palta a winh, snib'ej winh skol sb'a t'ay, yik max kan winh t'a k'ixwelal, yuj chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a Jesús: --¿Mach heb' yowalil tzin xajanej chi' syal chi'? xchi winh t'ay.

Yuj chi' ix yalxi jun ab'ix tik Jesús t'a winh: --Ha junel ay jun winh wan sb'ey t'a jun b'e skot t'a Jerusalén sk'och t'a Jericó. Ix yamji winh yuj juntzanh heb' elk'um. Ix laj elk'ajel tastak yet'nak winh yet' spichul winh. Ix mak'ji wekchaj winh, ijan ix cham winh smak'an heb'.
Haxo ix ek' jun winh sacerdote t'a jun b'e chi', tonhej ix b'atkan k'elan winh t'a winh, b'enhej ix ek'b'at winh.
Ix k'ochpax jun winh yinhtilal Leví, haxo ix yilanb'at winh ix mak'ji wekchaj chi' winh, ix sk'exb'e'an sb'a winh t'a winh, ix ek'b'at winh.
Palta ix ek'pax jun winh aj Samaria ta'. Ayik ix yilan winh, ix ok' sk'o'ol winh t'a winh.

Ix k'och winh t'a stz'ey winh, ix yanhtan winh, ix yak'anoch aceite winh yet' wino b'ajtak ix lajwi chi'. Ix sb'ak'an winh. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh schej, ix yik'anb'at winh b'aj ay posado, ix stanhwan winh ta'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix yak'anelta chab' tumin winh t'a winh ay yik posado chi', ix yalan winh: Tzil wal janik' jun winh pena'ay tik. Tato niwan tza laj yuj winh, ol in tup t'ayach a ol in jax junelxo, xchikan winh.
Yuj chi' tzin k'anb'ej t'ayach, ¿mach junok heb' winh oxwanh tik yetanima'il sb'a yet' winh ix yamji yuj heb' elk'um chi' tza na'a? xchi Jesús t'a winh k'ayb'um t'a ley Moisés chi'.
--Haton winh ix ok' sk'o'ol chi' t'a winh, xchi winh t'a Jesús. --Yel, hatoni. Yuj chi', ixik, icha chi' tzutej a b'a, xchi Jesús t'a winh.
Haxo ix b'at Jesús t'a yol b'e, ix k'och t'a jun aldea. Hata' ay jun ix skuch Marta. Ix scha'anoch Jesús chi' ix t'a yol spat.
Ay pax junxo ix snulej ix skuchan María. Ha ix María chi', ix em k'ojan ix t'a yichanh Jesús yik syab' ix tas syala'.

Haxo ix Marta chi', manh jantakok tas sk'ulej ix, ix k'och ix t'a Jesús chi', ix yalan ix: --Mamin, ¿tom max il jab'ok, to a ix in nulej tik, in yaktejkan ix t'a yol sk'ab' in munlajel tik in ch'okoj? Al t'a ix to skolwaj ix wet'ok, xchi ix.
Ix yalan Jesús t'a ix: --Marta, Marta, te ay ach och t'a ilk'olal yuj jantak tas tza k'ulej chi'.
Palta junnhej wal tas te yowalil sk'ulaji, haton jun chi' snib'ej ix María tik, yuj chi' malaj junok mach ol yal yik'anek' t'a ix, xchi t'a ix.
